Description: Behavioral FCDT data from Experiment 1 of Brüning et al. (2020). Original source variable names are preserved.

idx.Description: Number of the current row in the OSF source file.

VP.Description: Participant number in the OSF source file.

resource.Description: Type of resource competition. Level uni involves task pairs competing for the same perceptual-cognitive resources; level mix involves task pairs competing for different perceptual-cognitive resources.

Levels.mix: Task pairs competing for different perceptual-cognitive resources.
Levels.uni: Task pairs competing for the same perceptual-cognitive resources.

condition.Description: Experimental condition code in the OSF source file. The OSF workbook documents UniR, UniV, VgRk, and VkRg as the four combinations of verbal/spatial memory-search and classification tasks. The acronym components are read as Uni = uniform/same processing code, V = verbal, R = spatial/raeumlich, g = memory-search/Gedaechtnis, and k = classification/Klassifikation.

Levels.UniR: Uniform spatial condition: spatial memory-search task and spatial classification task; high resource competition because both tasks require spatial processing-code resources.
Levels.UniV: Uniform verbal condition: verbal memory-search task and verbal classification task; high resource competition because both tasks require verbal processing-code resources.
Levels.VgRk: Mixed verbal-memory/spatial-classification condition: verbal memory-search task and spatial classification task; low resource competition because verbal and spatial processing-code resources differ.
Levels.VkRg: Mixed spatial-memory/verbal-classification condition: spatial memory-search task and verbal classification task; low resource competition because spatial and verbal processing-code resources differ.

blockNo.Description: Number of the current block. A task-pair block entails two subblocks separated by a short break. This value was mapped to BIDS run labels by sorted order while the original value was preserved.

trial.Description: Continuously numbered trial within the current source (sub-)block.

task.Description: Currently performed component task. A denotes one of the two memory-search tasks, depending on condition; B denotes one of the two classification tasks, depending on condition.

Levels.A: Memory-search component task, depending on condition.
Levels.B: Classification component task, depending on condition.

stimulus.Description: Stimulus perceived by the participant. Image stimulus paths are normalized to paths relative to the BIDS stimuli directory; verbal stimuli are represented directly as text.

value.Description: Expected response. TRUE denotes memory target, same parity, or not mirrored; FALSE denotes the respective no response; missing values denote VoiceKey errors.

key.Description: Response given by the participant. TRUE denotes keys K/S or vocal response green; FALSE denotes keys L/A or vocal response red.

response.Description: Match of value with key. TRUE means the given response equals the expected response; FALSE means key and value differ.

stim_pres_ms.Description: Task-specific timestamp of the stimulus presentation. Inter-response intervals rather than simple reaction times are needed for the two task streams.

response_ms.Description: Timestamp of the response button or vocal response.
